learning_outcomes.text: Critically review the structure-properties relationships of advanced materials and techniques for performance improvements.
Relate how the properties and behaviour of materials govern their design and manufacture through consideration of the basic mechanisms involved.
Apply a range of techniques for improving the properties and performance of materials.
Select materials to meet the performance requirements of a range of engineering applications.

syllabus_topics: Structure and properties of advanced materials
Use of engineering principles in materials design and developments
Performance oriented materials design and selection
Use of modelling techniques in materials selection and product developments
Life cycle analysis of materials and structures
